The '''Corellian Merchants' Guild Guildhouse''' was located on [[Estalle Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]] in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. The Guildhouse was a hostel where [[Corellian Merchants' Guild/Legends|CMG]] members could get relatively cheap food and board even during [[Capital Season]]. It was not as large as the [[Corellian Merchants' Guild Guildhouse (Tallaan)|guildhouse]] located on [[Tallaan]] but it served the needs of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]]
nicely.
